prompts.name: wood
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated fantasy RTS worker character concept, a direct visual match for the supplied low-poly game model.
Input images: Image 1 is the front appearance reference and Image 2 is the back appearance reference of the SAME peon. These are identity, proportions, clothing, material, and render-style references.
Subject invariants: a short, bald, bright cyan-blue-skinned peon with a very large faceted round head, small round ears, oversized glossy blue-and-white eyes, thick dark eyebrows, tiny nose, friendly small mouth, mustard-yellow long-sleeved tunic with rolled cuffs, thin dark-brown belt and small square silver buckle, brown trousers and chunky brown cuffed boots. Match the references closely. The blue is skin, not a helmet. Keep the simple angular hands, squat proportions, plainly faceted polygon geometry, broad flat color planes and simple hard toon shadows of the screenshot. No hair, horns, pointy ears, armor, or added costume details.
Composition: one full-body character only, centered, walking toward the left of the image, three-quarter side/back view so the backpack load is clearly visible, with head turned slightly toward the viewer so both the recognizable face and the load are readable. Gentle forward lean under the load. Slightly elevated game-art camera. Entire head, load, hands, and boots in frame with generous margins. Plain warm light-gray background matching the reference; subtle ground shadow.
Render: clean low-poly 3D game screenshot aesthetic, not painterly, not photorealistic, not smooth high-detail Pixar rendering. No text, labels, watermark, extra characters, tools, scene, or UI.
Primary request: the peon is carrying a STACK OF CUT WOOD ON ITS BACK. Five or six short, chunky brown logs form a compact horizontal stack on the upper and middle back, tied securely together with two simple tan rope bindings and carried with plain rope shoulder straps. Make the whole stack visibly supported on the back, not floating and not held in the hands. The logs extend a little beyond the body width; show flat pale cut ends with a few simplified polygonal rings and coarse faceted bark. Keep log details as simple and low-poly as the peon. The hands lightly hold the shoulder straps near the chest. No sack, gold, axe, cart, or other cargo.
